name: horizon-bank-design
description: Generate visual mockups and aligned assets, design and build accessible Horizon Bank web experiences, and audit supported web source code with reusable identity, tokens, components, photography, iconography, and financial UX guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, build, and audit Horizon Bank web experiences.
interface.longDescription: Create visual mockups, aligned imagery and icons, and accessible Horizon Bank web and responsive-web experiences using the HB identity, semantic tokens, reusable financial patterns, editorial photography, and a production SVG icon system. The brand and experience guidance can inform other platforms, but native implementation libraries and source audits are not bundled.
defaultPrompt: Design a modern Horizon Bank experience.
Generate a Horizon Bank mockup, hero image, or icon.
Audit this UI against Horizon design guidance.
